author: Ethan Brooks
title: College Football Kickoff: Your Ultimate Guide
text:
College Football is Back: Your Guide to Surviving Kickoff Weekend After a long wait – 210 days since the CFP championship – college football has returned, and fans are rejoicing. It’s more than just a game; it’s a cultural phenomenon, a source of community, and for many, a deeply held tradition. Whether you’re tailgating, hosting a watch party, or experiencing the energy of homecoming, here’s how to navigate kickoff weekend with both spirit and sanity.
The “Sunday Personal Best” Uniform In the South, college football isn’t merely a pastime; it’s a religious experience. As with any significant occasion, game day demands your best attire. Across campuses, you’ll find students and alumni dressed to impress – frats in sport jackets, women in pearls and sundresses, and a sea of school colors.But the “game day fit” transcends mere fashion; it’s a visible declaration of allegiance before the first whistle blows.
Survival Kit Item: Show your team spirit with apparel in your school’s colors, or support a Black-owned brand like Black & Scholared if you’re team-less.
The Emotional Snack Drawer The menu is just as crucial as the matchup itself. From brats sizzling on a Big Ten grill to turkey legs and vibrant red drinks at a Classic tailgate, the food is frequently enough a primary draw. Your lucky charm might be a generous helping of smoked wings, creamy mac and cheese, or a beloved aunt’s potato salad.Regardless of location, the golden rule of tailgating is simple: nobody goes hungry before kickoff.
Survival Kit Item: Elevate your spread with seasonings from Black-owned brands like Spiceology or Simply Season.
The Soundtrack to Victory The band is the headliner.
Survival Kit Item: Amplify the experience at home with a House of Marley eco-friendly speaker,or ensure little ones are pleasant with noise-cancelling headphones at the game.
The Rituals That Matter Every campus boasts its own sacred traditions.
Howard Homecoming transforms into a pilgrimage to Yardfest.
Ohio State dots the “i” in Script Ohio.
Texas A&M holds Midnight Yell with gospel-like fervor.
Clemson players charge down “The Hill.”
Wisconsin bounces to “Jump Around.”
Auburn’s Tiger Walk draws thousands to the streets.
The Bayou Classic in new Orleans? The halftime show is the main event.
These chants, strolls, and prayer circles connect fans across generations, transforming a game into a shared experience with family.
Survival Kit Item: Prepare for excited yelling with cough drops, throat lozenges, headache medicine, and electrolytes – a sore throat and hangover won’t cure themselves.
The Cool-Down Plan The game may end, but the rivalries endure. Win or lose, fans gather in bars, cookouts, and block parties.Alumni reconnect, families share stories, and the band continues to play long after the final whistle. A key survival tip: pace yourself – it’s a long season.
Survival Kit Item: Celebrate (or commiserate) with Black-owned spirits like Uncle Nearest whiskey, McBride Sisters wine, and crowns & Hops Brewing Co.
Keeping Score Whether your team is a playoff contender or you’re simply there for the tailgate, you’re part of something larger than yourself. College football season is a tradition, a community, and the best time of the year.
So,as the season kicks off,ensure your survival kit is ready,offer a prayer for your team,and remember: the scoreboard will fade,but the memories will last forever.
